findings.title: Lifecycle presence records need an explicit player target
findings.claim: The new lifecycle presence payload records whether someone is present but does not identify whose presence changes. The existing lifecycle journal wrapper supplies no player identity either.
findings.evidence: spec L177 specifies `{present: false}` / `{present: true}` inside a lifecycle JournalControl. src/renderer/src/authority/core.ts:L18 contains only source, order, ordinal and control for lifecycle records; L192-L202 associates each live binding with a players array. spec L250 explicitly allows two player IDs on one link.
findings.why: Replay has no live binding from which to recover the affected player. Disconnecting player 0 and disconnecting player 1 can therefore produce indistinguishable presence records with different required simulation outcomes.
findings.fix: Define a discriminated lifecycle presence control carrying a player ID, or an explicit player-ID list. Specify that attach/detach records all affected binding players, with deterministic ordering, and extend JournalControl's control union accordingly. Replay must apply those recorded targets without consulting transport bindings.

prior.note: spec L91 separates gravity-only and dissipative tests and supplies numerical bounds; L129 aligns the skid feel target with 60 u/s.
